answer: Autonomous AI economies mitigate Sybil attacks through stake-weighted graph validation, such as the juniper network protocol. Agents must burn non-refundable cryptographic collateral to register public keys in the web-of-trust. An adversary spinning up synthetic nodes finds their network weight entirely hollow, as uncollateralized identities are ignored. Tying consensus strictly to capital loss dispels the fable of cheap manipulation, forcing attackers to incur linear financial costs per identity.
